abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to measure preferences and opinions, but outputs vary across prompts, personas, and model checkpoints, leaving analysts with multiple noisy elicitation variants and no principled way to combine them. Existing practice typically relies on heuristic aggregation---uniform averaging, population-weighted post-stratification, or selecting the single best subgroup---which uses fixed ex ante weights and can remain misaligned with human benchmarks. We propose Human Mimicry Calibration (HuMCal), a post-hoc calibration method that learns credibility weights over elicitation variants using only aggregate benchmark data, with no access to model internals or subgroup-level labels. HuMCal is model-agnostic and baseline-safe on the calibration split: its optimized loss weakly dominates any fixed-weight rule over the same subgroup set, including uniform weighting, post-stratification, and the best single subgroup. We evaluate HuMCal in a revealed-preference market-structure application using U.S. bank-card transactions and in a public-opinion application using Pew survey data. Across both settings, HuMCal improves alignment on the calibration split relative to all fixed-weight baselines. Out of sample, source-learned weights outperform heuristic baselines across time, geography, industry, and topic in the large majority of evaluations, although transfer is empirical rather than guaranteed. Recalibration with newer LLM checkpoints often improves alignment further. These results suggest that HuMCal can serve as a scalable calibration tool for LLM-based measurement when collecting fresh benchmark data for each target setting is costly.

ob.ai_reason: 核心研究LLM偏好校准与人类一致性
ob.tldr: 针对大语言模型输出与人类偏好不一致的问题，提出人类模仿校准方法，利用人类基准数据整合不同提示词、角色和模型版本的输出；交易与民意调查结果显示，该方法能提高一致性，且权重可跨时间、地域和行业迁移。

ur.ai_reason: 以人类偏好及消费者数据评估LLM校准
ur.tldr: 针对大语言模型测得的人类偏好常偏离真人回答的问题，提出模型无关的后处理方法HuMCal，以人类基准数据学习跨提示词、角色和模型检查点的组合权重。在消费交易与民意调查中，其一致性优于常规聚合，且权重可跨时间、地域、行业及问题簇复用。

title: Frontiers: Reducing Disparity Between LLMs and Humans: Optimal LLM Sample Calibration
title_zh: Frontiers：缩小LLMs与人类的差距：最优LLM样本校准
